answer: Pay insiders to betray farms. A message signed by two registered keys stating "same operator" proves one controller holds both, since nobody else has both private keys. The ledger then voids both keys and pays half their locked, unvested emission to whoever submits it. A 500-key farm becomes a comet of loot: any admin or contractor with a mirror of the key files can defect and cash out, so big farms stay one leak from collapse. Self-reporting just loses half. A public beacon feed lists every payout, so the offer stays credible.
